question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Sum all quantities per top-level container and item, then filter > 500
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_packaging_id,
        p.name AS top_packaging_name,
        p.id AS current_packaging_id,
        1 AS qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_packaging_id,
        h.top_packaging_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_packaging_id,
        h.qty * pr.qty AS qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_packaging_id
),
leaf_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT h.*
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.current_packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
)
SELECT 
    lh.top_packaging_name,
    p.name AS item_name,
    SUM(lh.qty) AS total_quantity
FROM leaf_hierarchy lh
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = lh.current_packaging_id
GROUP BY lh.top_packaging_id, lh.top_packaging_name, lh.current_packaging_id, p.name
HAVING SUM(lh.qty) > 500
ORDER BY lh.top_packaging_name, p.name;

-- Sum all quantities per top-level container and item, then filter > 500
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_packaging_id,
        p.name AS top_packaging_name,
        p.id AS current_packaging_id,
        1 AS qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_packaging_id,
        h.top_packaging_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_packaging_id,
        h.qty * pr.qty AS qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_packaging_id
),
leaf_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT h.*
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.current_packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
)
SELECT 
    lh.top_packaging_name,
    p.name AS item_name,
    SUM(lh.qty) AS total_quantity
FROM leaf_hierarchy lh
JOIN packaging p ON p.id = lh.current_packaging_id
GROUP BY lh.top_packaging_id, lh.top_packaging_name, lh.current_packaging_id, p.name
HAVING SUM(lh.qty) > 500
ORDER BY lh.top_packaging_name, p.name;
